title: malvastrum acaule
intro: Malvastrum acaule, commonly known as the "bushy mallow," is a plant species that belongs to the family Malvaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The health benefits of Malvastrum acaule include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating pain, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
